description: Low-level edit of any project setting by JSON Pointer path (read how_to once for the format, get_shot for a real shot). Each change: {"op":"replace"|"add"|"remove"|"merge","path":"/scenes/0/shots/1/seconds","value":4}. All changes in one call are one undo step; a bad path or value is refused and nothing changes. Returns { done: number of changes }. Prefer the specific tools (set_cast, direct_cast, set_text, set_camera, set_light, set_place, set_transition, set_keyframes); use this only for fields they don't cover.

changes.description: The changes, applied in order as one undo step.

op.description: replace a value, add one (append to a list with path ending '-'), remove it, or merge fields into an object.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the project, like "/scenes/0/shots/1/seconds".

value.description: The new value. Not needed for remove.

label.description: What the person sees in the undo note, like 'Claude made shot 2 longer.'

name: edit_project
